language.name: English
main.home.captureHint: Click the button on the right, or use {shortcut}, to start a capture.
main.home.shortcutTaken: {shortcut} is taken by another application, so the shortcut does not work.
main.capture.startModeHint: The capture mode used by default. With All monitors, the selection screen is skipped and the capture is taken directly.
main.capture.hideOwnWindowsHint: Automatically hides Perora's settings, editor and preview while capturing.
main.capture.copyHint: The image is copied to the clipboard automatically as soon as the preview appears.
main.capture.clear: Clear the clipboard with the Discard button
main.capture.clearHint: Pressing the Discard button also removes the image from the clipboard.
main.capture.afterHint: After a capture, choose between showing a small preview, opening the editor directly, or copying only.
main.capture.previewSecondsHint:
How many seconds the preview stays without being used. (Up to 3600 seconds)
With 0, it stays where it is until it is used.
main.capture.previewCornerHint: Where the preview appears after a capture.
main.capture.soundHint: The sound played when a capture is taken. (It is played once when you choose it)
main.capture.enableUploadHint: Shows an Upload button in the preview and the editor, to post directly to i.f2a.dev.
main.capture.enableUploadSignedOut: Sign in on the Account page to switch this on.
main.capture.uploadImmediatelyHint: Skips the preview and uploads at once.
main.save.onCapture: Save the original of every capture
main.save.onCaptureHint: Each capture is saved to the folder as it was taken, before any editing, without asking where.
main.save.onCaptureAsHint: The same as saving above, or a format and size of its own.
main.save.deleteOnDiscardHint: Discarding a capture in the preview also deletes the file saved automatically.
main.output.saveOnCaptureHint: The format of the saved originals (more than one can be chosen) and how far they are reduced.
main.save.ask: Ask where to save every time
main.save.askHint: When off, captures are saved to the save folder automatically.
main.output.copyHint: Copies to the clipboard as PNG, JPG or WebP. The size can be reduced too.
main.output.uploadHint: Uploads as PNG, JPG or WebP. The size can be reduced too.
main.output.saveHint: The format of the saved files (more than one can be chosen) and how far they are reduced.
main.output.qualityHint:
For WebP, Best is lossless; PNG is always lossless, whatever is set here.
Applies to copying, uploading and saving alike.
main.shortcut.captureHint: The shortcut that starts a capture.
main.shortcut.recording: Press the new key combination. Esc cancels.
main.shortcut.snippingHint:
Pressing Win + Shift + S opens Perora's selection screen instead of the Windows Snipping Tool.
While this is on, the shortcut is fixed to Win + Shift + S and cannot be changed.
While this is on, the Win + S search shortcut is disabled as well and does nothing.

Note: once this is enabled, the Windows Snipping Tool is disabled and cannot be used, even while Perora is not running.
main.shortcut.snippingWaits: This counts once Explorer has restarted, or you have signed in again.
main.shortcut.snippingGivenBack: The Windows snipping tool is back once Explorer has restarted, or you have signed in again.
main.shortcut.restartShellHint: Restarting it takes the taskbar away for a moment and closes the folders that are open.
main.shortcut.invalid: {shortcut} cannot be used as a shortcut.
main.general.languageHint: The language used for the interface.
main.general.themeHint: The theme Perora is shown in.
main.general.startAtSignInHint: Starts Perora automatically when Windows starts.
main.general.startMinimizedHint: In the tray, without its window. Off, the window opens as Perora starts.
main.general.noticeSecondsHint:
How many seconds a notice stays without being clicked. (Up to 3600 seconds)
With 0, it stays where it is until it is clicked.
main.general.noticeSoundHint: The sound played with a notice. (It is played once when you choose it)
main.account.signedOutHint: Signing in lets you upload directly to i.f2a.dev.
main.account.waiting: Waiting for the sign-in in the browser
main.account.mayNotUpload: This account may not upload yet. An administrator has to allow it.
main.account.recentUnreachable: The server could not be reached.
main.update.title: Perora {version} is available
main.update.installing: Installing. Perora restarts once it is done.
main.update.captureInHand: Save or discard the image in the preview before updating. Perora restarts automatically when it updates.
main.general.versionHint: Checks for updates at startup and every six hours.
main.general.versionHint.failed: Something went wrong while checking for a new version.
notify.updateFound: Perora {version} has been released. Click to open.
error.updateCaptureInHand: Save or discard the image in the preview before updating. Perora restarts automatically when it updates.
error.updateGone: No new version was found. Please try again later.
notify.uploaded: Uploaded. The link is on the clipboard.
notify.uploadedNotCopied: Uploaded, but the link could not be copied: {url}
notify.notSignedIn: Not signed in. Sign in on the Account page of Perora's window.
notify.savedSeveral: Saved to {path}, and as {others} more kinds beside it
notify.savedAsTakenSeveral: Saved to {path} automatically, and as {others} more kinds beside it
notify.copiedAndSaved: The capture is on the clipboard, and saved to {path}
notify.savedButNotCopied: Saved to {path} automatically, but not put on the clipboard: {detail}
notify.copiedButNotSaved: The capture is on the clipboard, but could not be saved automatically: {detail}
notify.notSavedAsTaken: The capture could not be saved automatically: {detail}
notify.copied: The capture is on the clipboard.
notify.notCopied: The capture could not be put on the clipboard: {detail}
preview.as: {what}: kind of file and size, this once
preview.copiedBefore: The latest changes are not on the clipboard. Copy again.
preview.copyFailed: The image could not be copied: {detail}
preview.saveFailed: The image could not be saved: {detail}
editor.full: The limit of edit layers was reached. Remove some, or save or upload it as it is.
editor.fullWithoutUpload: The limit of edit layers was reached. Remove some, or save it as it is.
editor.unmade: The image with your drawing could not be made. Please try again.
overlay.hint.smart: Click a window, or drag a rectangle
overlay.hint.window: Pick a window from the list
error.capture: The screen could not be captured: {detail}
error.windowsLost: Perora could not bring its windows back. Exit Perora from its icon in the notification area and start it again.
error.forbidden: This account may not upload yet. An administrator has to allow it.
error.tooLarge: The image is larger than the server accepts.
error.unreachable: The server could not be reached. The image was not uploaded.
error.signInTimedOut: Signing in was not completed in time. Try again on the Account page.
error.signInUnreachable: The sign-in service could not be reached.
tour.again: You can watch this tour again from here at any time.
tour.capture.modes: Choose how to capture. The number keys 1 to 5 switch too.
tour.capture.window: In Smart mode, point at a window and click to capture that window.
tour.capture.cancel: Press Esc or Cancel to stop capturing.
tour.preview.picture: Click the picture to open the editor.
tour.preview.as: The arrow beside a button picks the kind of file and the size, for this capture only.
tour.editor.tools: Choose a drawing tool. Point at a button to see the key that switches to it.
tour.editor.wheel: Hold the right mouse button over the picture and turn the wheel to go through the tools.
tour.editor.right: Double-click the right mouse button over the picture to show the options of the tool in hand, right there. They also come up when you press the tool's button.
tour.editor.select: Select: click something drawn to select it. Besides moving it and changing its size, you can change its colour, size and other settings afterwards: they come up when you double-click the right mouse button, or press the select button again. Ctrl + click selects several things, and dragging selects what is in an area. Ctrl + C / X / V copy, cut and paste; Ctrl + D duplicates.
tour.editor.zoom: Turn the wheel to zoom in and out. Drag with Space held down, or with the wheel button, to move around. Press 0 to see the whole picture.
tour.editor.actions: Upload, save, copy or discard. Ctrl + Enter uploads; Esc discards.
tour.editor.actionsWithoutUpload: Save, copy or discard. Ctrl + Enter saves; Esc discards.
tour.editor.status: Shows what is on the clipboard. After drawing, copy again to put the new version there.
tour.choice: Choose the kind of file (PNG, JPG, WebP), and the size: as it is, or made to fit within so many pixels. The kind, size and quality used every time are set in the settings, under Capture (and Save, for saving).
tour.tool.pen: Pen: draws a line wherever you drag.
tour.tool.marker: Marker: goes over text like a highlighter, to make it stand out.
tour.tool.shapes: Shapes: rectangles, ellipses, lines and arrows. Chosen by its button, a bar comes down to choose the shape, its fill and its outline.
tour.tool.text: Text: writes where you click. Font, size, colour and outline can be set.
tour.tool.stamp: Numbers: puts 1, 2, 3… where you click, one after another.
tour.tool.hide: Blur and mosaic: makes the area you drag unreadable. Chosen by its button, a bar comes down to choose which, and how strong.
tour.tool.crop: Crop: keeps only the part of the picture you want. A shape can be chosen; Enter crops.
